name: TrendSpider
description: Manage access to privately shared TrendSpider content through its documented sharing API. Grants or revokes access for an existing TrendSpider account. This API does not retrieve trading signals; signal alerts use outbound webhooks.

credential_fields.name: item_id
credential_fields.label: Shared Item ID
credential_fields.description: Share an item to certain people only, then open Sharing Management > API > Copy credentials. The first part is itemId. Each connection represents one shared item.

credential_fields.name: secret_key
credential_fields.label: Shared Item Secret Key
credential_fields.description: Second part of the copied itemId/secretKey credentials. Re-sharing an item regenerates its secret key.

tools.name: grant_access
tools.description: Grant access to the configured shared item for an existing TrendSpider account. The change takes effect immediately.

email.description: One existing TrendSpider account email address, with no spaces.

tools.name: revoke_access
tools.description: Revoke access to the configured shared item for an existing TrendSpider account. The change takes effect immediately.

email.description: One existing TrendSpider account email address, with no spaces.
